game.name: Life Tutorial
game.desc: A 3-4 minute hands-on tutorial for Conway's Game of Life: the rules and the controls, learned by doing. Start here.

game.name: Life Free Mode
game.desc: Draw and run anything on a 16384x16384 grid. Includes huge presets: a clock, 8/16-bit computers, a Turing machine, a prime calculator.

game.name: Life Challenge
game.desc: Build the target shape against the clock on a grid that keeps evolving underneath you. Top 5 records are kept per round.

game.name: Life Battle
game.desc: 1 vs 1. Place your cells with a 60-second, 60-cell budget, then run 600 generations and win on colour majority.
